tiers.name: Loosening Up
tiers.sub: Nobody's drunk yet. That's the problem.
tiers.bust: Bottled it — drink 2 and hand the phone over.

missions.t: Trying to make me laugh
missions.b: Get a real laugh out of them. Not the polite one — the ugly one, the one they'd be mortified to hear played back.
missions.w: They drink 2 — and they owe you that laugh on demand for the rest of the night.
missions.l: Drink 2. You're not as funny as you think.

missions.t: Trying to make me say your name
missions.b: Get them to say your name out loud. You are not allowed to say theirs — not once.
missions.w: They drink 2, then say your name one more time, slower.
missions.l: Drink 2, and say their name like you mean it.

missions.t: Trying to get me to touch you first
missions.b: Get them to make physical contact with you — any contact at all — without you touching them first.
missions.w: They drink 2 and leave that hand exactly where it is.
missions.l: Drink 2. Hands to yourself for the next round.

missions.t: Fishing for a compliment
missions.b: Get them to compliment you on something specific. Fishing is allowed. Begging is not.
missions.w: They drink 2 and give you a second compliment — filthier than the first.
missions.l: Drink 2 and compliment them instead.

missions.t: Trying to make me look away first
missions.b: Hold eye contact and make them break it first. You may not mention that you're doing it.
missions.w: They drink 2 — eyes on you the whole time.
missions.l: Drink 2 and blink as much as you like.

missions.t: Copying everything I do
missions.b: Mirror them. Every gesture, every shift, every sip — half a beat behind, and subtle enough to miss.
missions.w: They drink 2, then copy your next move exactly.
missions.l: Drink 2, you absolute parrot.

missions.t: Trying to make me swear
missions.b: Get a swear word out of them. You can't swear yourself — one slip and you've lost it.
missions.w: They drink 2 for the potty mouth.
missions.l: Drink 2, you sweet innocent thing.

missions.t: Slipping a lie into the conversation
missions.b: Work one completely invented detail into the conversation and get them to accept it without blinking.
missions.w: They drink 2, and the lie is canon for the rest of the night.
missions.l: Drink 2 and confess the lie.

tiers.name: Two Drinks In
tiers.bust: Bottled it — drink 3 and lose a layer.

missions.t: Trying to make me blush
missions.b: Say the thing that turns them red. Not shocking — specific. You know exactly which memory does it.
missions.w: They drink 3 while you watch.
missions.l: Drink 3. Turns out they're shameless.

missions.t: Trying to get me out of something I'm wearing
missions.b: Get one item off them without ever asking them to remove it. Socks count. Barely.
missions.w: They drink 3, and it stays off.
missions.l: Drink 3 and lose something yourself.

missions.t: Trying to get me to confess something
missions.b: Get them to tell you something they have genuinely never told you before.
missions.w: They drink 3. You get one follow-up question, and they have to answer it.
missions.l: Drink 3 and confess something of your own instead.

missions.t: Trying to make me kiss you
missions.b: Get them to kiss you. They have to move first — you can lean, linger and cheat, but you cannot close the gap.
missions.w: They drink 3. Then do it again properly, and let them.
missions.l: Drink 3. So close.

missions.t: Trying to make me lose my train of thought
missions.b: Get them talking about something they care about — then derail them so completely they forget the sentence.
missions.w: They drink 3 and try to finish it anyway.
missions.l: Drink 3. Their focus is annoyingly good.

missions.t: Trying to get me to say I love you
missions.b: Get them to say it first, unprompted. You may not say it yourself.
missions.w: They drink 3. Say it back, obviously.
missions.l: Drink 3 and say it first, out loud, no mumbling.

missions.t: Trying to make me nervous
missions.b: Build a little tension. Get them fidgeting, laughing at the wrong moment, or asking "what?" twice.
missions.w: They drink 3 and admit what got to them.
missions.l: Drink 3. Ice cold, apparently.

missions.t: Trying to get me to dare you
missions.b: Get them to dare you to do something. It has to be their idea, in their words.
missions.w: They drink 3 — and now you do the dare anyway, in front of them.
missions.l: Drink 3 and take a dare from them instead.

tiers.name: No Filter
tiers.sub: Whatever you've been saving — say it now.
tiers.bust: Bottled it — drink 4 and lose an item.

missions.t: Trying to make me say something filthy
missions.b: Get an unmistakably dirty sentence out of their mouth. Innuendo doesn't count. Explicit or nothing.
missions.w: They drink 4, then repeat it slower.
missions.l: Drink 4 and say something filthy yourself.

missions.t: Trying to make me beg
missions.b: Get them to ask you for something twice. The second one has to sound like begging.
missions.w: They drink 4. Make them wait a little longer anyway.
missions.l: Drink 4. You're the one begging now.

missions.t: Trying to get me half undressed
missions.b: By the buzzer they should be wearing meaningfully less. You may not ask, order, or undress them yourself.
missions.w: They drink 4. Whatever came off is not going back on.
missions.l: Drink 4 and lose two items to make up for it.

missions.t: Trying to make me lose it completely
missions.b: Break them. Giggling, snorting, tears, total collapse. No tickling — you have to earn it.
missions.w: They drink 4, once they can breathe again.
missions.l: Drink 4 in the silence you've created.

missions.t: Trying to get a fantasy out of me
missions.b: Get them to describe something they want. Actual detail — not "you know, stuff".
missions.w: They drink 4, and one detail of it happens before the night is over.
missions.l: Drink 4 and tell them one of yours.

missions.t: Trying to make me touch you somewhere specific
missions.b: Pick one spot — right now, in your head. Get their hands there without saying a word about it.
missions.w: They drink 4 and stay there for a full minute.
missions.l: Drink 4 and tell them where you wanted it.

missions.t: Trying to make me finish my drink
missions.b: Empty their glass. Toasts, dares, distraction, sabotage. You cannot tell them to drink.
missions.w: They finish whatever's left, then pour another.
missions.l: Drink 4. They're pacing themselves better than you.

missions.t: Trying to get me to take you to bed
missions.b: Get them to suggest ending the game. It has to come from them, out loud, in plain words.
missions.w: They drink 4 — and the game ends when you say it does.
missions.l: Drink 4. The round continues.

missions.t: Hunting for where I'm ticklish
missions.b: Find a spot that makes them squirm — and don't be obvious about looking for it.
missions.w: They lose one item, and you get to use that spot whenever you like tonight.
missions.l: Lose one item, and let them find yours.

missions.t: Trying to make me sigh
missions.b: Earn one audible sigh. Not a laugh, not a word — that sound.
missions.w: They lose one item.
missions.l: Lose one item. Silence is expensive.

missions.t: Trying to get me to close my eyes
missions.b: Get their eyes shut, and keep them shut, without ever asking.
missions.w: They lose one item and keep their eyes closed through the next round.
missions.l: Lose one item. Eyes open, then.

missions.t: Trying to get me to ask you to keep going
missions.b: Start something good. Slow right down. Get them to ask for more, out loud.
missions.w: They lose one item — and then you keep going.
missions.l: Lose one item, and ask them nicely instead.

missions.t: Trying to get me out of something
missions.b: One item off them by the buzzer. You may not ask, and you may not use both hands.
missions.w: It stays off, and they lose one more.
missions.l: Lose two items yourself.

missions.t: Trying to make me hold my breath
missions.b: Do something that makes them stop breathing for a second. You'll know it when it lands.
missions.w: They lose one item.
missions.l: Lose one item and breathe easy.

missions.t: Trying to make me pull you closer
missions.b: Stay just out of reach until they close the distance themselves. Hands, hips, anything — they move first.
missions.w: They lose one item, then pull you closer again.
missions.l: Lose one item and close the gap yourself.

missions.t: Trying to make me shiver
missions.b: Breath, fingertips, ice, anything slow or cold. One visible shiver.
missions.w: They lose one item.
missions.l: Lose one item. Warm-blooded, that one.

tiers.name: Hands On
tiers.bust: Bottled it — lose an item, and give them sixty seconds using no hands.

missions.t: Trying to make me make a sound
missions.b: One real sound out of them. Not a word, not a laugh. You know the one.
missions.w: They lose an item, and do it again — louder.
missions.l: Lose an item and stay quiet about it.

missions.t: Hunting for a spot I didn't know I had
missions.b: Find somewhere on them neither of you has ever paid attention to. Then prove it works.
missions.w: They lose an item, and you get sixty more seconds right there.
missions.l: Lose an item. Fully mapped already, apparently.

missions.t: Trying to make me grab your hair
missions.b: Get their hands into your hair. Not placed there — grabbed.
missions.w: They lose an item, and they don't let go.
missions.l: Lose an item, and put their hand where you wanted it.

missions.t: Trying to make me stop you
missions.b: Push it far enough that they have to say wait, slow down, or not yet.
missions.w: They lose an item. Then carry on exactly where you left off.
missions.l: Lose an item. They never flinched.

missions.t: Trying to get me to say please
missions.b: Whatever they want next, make them use the word.
missions.w: They lose an item, and say it once more.
missions.l: Lose an item. Please.

missions.t: Trying to get me on top of you
missions.b: End the round with them over you — without asking, pulling, or announcing it.
missions.w: They lose an item and stay right there.
missions.l: Lose an item and get on top yourself.

missions.t: Trying to make me kiss you somewhere new
missions.b: Get their mouth somewhere it hasn't been tonight. Guide them with everything except words.
missions.w: They lose an item and go back for longer.
missions.l: Lose an item, and show them where you meant.

missions.t: Trying to make me lose track of my hands
missions.b: Get them distracted enough that their hands end up somewhere they didn't decide on.
missions.w: They lose an item, and their hands stay exactly where they landed.
missions.l: Lose an item. Impressive self-control.

tiers.name: Point of No Return
tiers.sub: The game is nearly over. Make it count.
tiers.bust: Bottled it — everything comes off, and they own the next sixty seconds.

missions.t: Trying to make me beg
missions.b: Get them asking. Then get them asking again. Don't give in while the clock is still running.
missions.w: Everything they're still wearing comes off. Then, finally, give them what they asked for.
missions.l: Strip to nothing, and beg them instead.

missions.t: Trying to take me to the edge
missions.b: Get them as close as you can without going over. Read them properly — the clock is not the point.
missions.w: They're yours. No rules at all for the next five minutes.
missions.l: They take over, and you don't get a say in what happens next.

missions.t: Trying to make me say your name
missions.b: Get your name out of their mouth the way you want to hear it. Not conversationally.
missions.w: They lose everything that's left, and say it once more, slower.
missions.l: Say theirs — loudly — then do whatever they ask.

missions.t: Trying to make me give up control
missions.b: Get them to hand it over. "Do what you want", "you decide", or the wordless version.
missions.w: You're in charge until the game ends. They move only when told.
missions.l: They're in charge. Same rules, other way round.

missions.t: Trying to get me to say exactly what I want
missions.b: No hints, no maybes. Get them to say the actual sentence, in the actual words.
missions.w: They lose everything that's left — and you do exactly what they said.
missions.l: Tell them yours instead. In full, with the lights on.

missions.t: Trying to make me tear something off you
missions.b: Get them to undress you impatiently. No calm folding. You may not lift a finger to help.
missions.w: Whatever's left of theirs goes too, and they don't get to be gentle about it.
missions.l: Undress yourself while they watch. Slowly.

missions.t: Trying to make me forget this game exists
missions.b: Make them stop thinking about the phone, the clock and the rules entirely.
missions.w: Game over — you've won the night. Put the phone down and don't pick it up again.
missions.l: They were counting the seconds. Do better.

missions.t: Trying to make me finish what you started
missions.b: Start something you have no intention of finishing yourself. Hand it over at the buzzer.
missions.w: They finish it. All of it. You just have to lie there.
missions.l: You finish it — and they'll be watching.
